channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: 2026 NHL Draft Rankings: Ryan Kennedy's Mid-Season Top 32
item.description: With a cluster of four players at the top of the NHL draft class, prospect expert Ryan Kennedy's mid-season rankings feature a new No. 1.

item.title: Macklin Celebrini Plays Hockey The Right Way. Be Like Macklin Celebrini
item.description: After trying to wave off a high-sticking penalty against the Edmonton Oilers, everyone should play the game like San Jose Sharks sophomore Macklin Celebrini.

item.title: Getting To Know The Real Tom Wilson: Capitals Star Reflects On Evolution & Winding Road To Olympics
item.description: Washington Capitals right winger Tom Wilson is one of the NHL's top power forwards and most fascinating characters. He knew what he had to do to make The Show — and when he had to change.

item.title: Maple Leafs Not Only Need To Keep Scott Laughton, They Must Use Him Better
item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs center Scott Laughton is a pending UFA. But instead of trading him, the Leafs should keep him for the long term. And they need to play him more.

item.title: Three NHL Veterans Who Could Use A Change Of Scenery
item.description: Whether it's getting healthy scratched or seeing a significant decrease in ice time, these NHL veterans look like they could use a spark by the trade deadline.

item.title: Six NHL Dynamic Duos Going To The 2026 Olympics
item.description: With not much time to build chemistry at the Olympic Games, some nations will have an advantage in taking duos and trios from their respective NHL teams. Here are some of those groups that will be going to the Olympics.

item.title: Hockey Having A Hollywood Moment With Hit TV Shows Growing The NHL
item.description: The hockey world's grip on pop culture is tightening with critically-acclaimed series Heated Rivalry and Shoresy capturing the zeitgeist. Hockey is having its Hollywood moment, and that can only be a good thing.

item.title: The Best Pre-Game Get-Ups And Outfits For NHL Outdoor Games In Recent Memory
item.description: In the event of the 2026 Stadium Series between the Boston Bruins and Tampa Bay Lightning, here are some of the best pre-game outfits for NHL outdoor games in recent memory

item.title: Bruins Should Tread Lightly Amid Retool And Buy Cheap At NHL's Trade Deadline
item.description: The Boston Bruins embarked on a soft retool last season, and this year, they've rebounded into a stronger team. But Bruins GM Don Sweeney faces a trade deadline dilemma: make big moves or subtle tweaks?

item.title: Pair Of Maple Leafs Defensemen Would Fetch The Best Return For Toronto
item.description: The struggling Toronto Maple Leafs need to trade many veterans by this year's trade deadline. Moving defensemen Oliver Ekman-Larsson and Brandon Carlo are going to get the Leafs the biggest return.
